question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Far and wide
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Everywhere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Far and wide"** means across a large area or everywhere. (हर जगह)

 
 
• **Example:** News of the discovery spread far and wide, reaching even the smallest villages.
 
 

 
• **"Everywhere"** means in all places or locations; it is synonymous with "Far and wide." (हर जगह)

 
 
• **Example:** She searched everywhere for her lost keys but couldn't find them.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom **'Far and wide'** is **'Everywhere'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **By itself** (स्वयं): Without help or assistance; independently.

 
 
• **Example:** The machine works perfectly by itself without any manual intervention.
 
 
 
• **To give away a secret** (राज़ को उजागर करना): To reveal or disclose confidential information.
 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally gave away the secret about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **Now and then** (कभी-कभी): Occasionally; not very often.
 
 
• **Example:** She visits her grandparents now and then when she has time.
